'''Dozy''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Critters|Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Snoozebo]] at 4 stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Dozy sometimes nods off mid-fight against [[Zobos]], but that doesn't seem to slow down the Zobo-bashing one bit."

Dozy is an early game, blue rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
Dozy is a hedgehog with brown fur, darker brown quills, and a tan underbelly. It has pink blush, closed eyes, small ears, and a little x where it would have a bellybutton. It has short legs, and mostly sits on its rear, unmoving.  

== Trivia ==

* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "It tends to fall asleep while fighting Zobos, but that doesn't seem to reduce its fighting ability."
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "The spikes along Dozy's back are rock-solid. Dozy spends sixteen hours a day asleep, even when danger approaches."

==Strategy==
[[File:Dozy Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Dozy's attack range]]
Good early/mid Rock tank. Pairs best with a healer in the back and a slowing DPS to maximize its Counter Spike.
{{clear|left}}
